position-sizing.name: Position Sizing Calculator
position-sizing.intro: Compute the position size from account equity, risk per trade and stop-loss distance.

beta-calc.name: Beta Coefficient Calculator
beta-calc.intro: Compute a stock's beta from its returns relative to the market.

technical-indicator.name: Technical Indicator Calculator
technical-indicator.intro: Compute common technical indicators such as moving averages, RSI and MACD.

calc-30.name: Max Drawdown Calculator
calc-30.intro: Compute the maximum drawdown from a price series peak and trough.

calc-1.name: Stock Profit/Loss Calculator
calc-1.intro: Compute stock trading profit or loss from buy and sell prices and share count.

calc-29.name: Bollinger Bands Calculator
calc-29.intro: Compute Bollinger Band upper and lower bands from a moving average and standard deviation.

bond-convexity.name: Bond Convexity Calculator
bond-convexity.intro: Compute the convexity of a bond from its cash flows and yield.

market-risk-premium.name: Market Risk Premium Calculator
market-risk-premium.intro: Compute the market risk premium as market return minus the risk-free rate.

book-value-per-share.name: Book Value Per Share Calculator
book-value-per-share.intro: Compute book value per share from net assets, preferred stock and shares outstanding.

black-scholes-call.name: Black-Scholes Call Price Calculator
black-scholes-call.intro: Price a European call option with the Black-Scholes model.

black-scholes-put.name: Black-Scholes Put Price Calculator
black-scholes-put.intro: Price a European put option with the Black-Scholes model.

capm-beta.name: CAPM Beta Calculator
capm-beta.intro: Compute beta as the covariance of asset and market returns divided by market variance.

beta-covariance.name: Beta from Covariance Calculator
beta-covariance.intro: Compute beta from the covariance of stock and market returns and the market variance.

holding-return-stock.name: Holding Period Return Calculator
holding-return-stock.intro: Compute holding period return from buy and sell prices and dividends received.

book-to-market.name: Book-to-Market Ratio Calculator
book-to-market.intro: Compute the book-to-market ratio from book value per share and price.

option-breakeven-put.name: Put Option Breakeven Calculator
option-breakeven-put.intro: Compute the breakeven price of a put option from strike price and premium.

margin-requirement.name: Margin Requirement Calculator
margin-requirement.intro: Compute the margin ratio from account equity and position market value.

price-to-book.name: Price-to-Book Ratio Calculator
price-to-book.intro: Compute the price-to-book ratio from share price and book value per share.

option-breakeven-call.name: Call Option Breakeven Calculator
option-breakeven-call.intro: Compute the breakeven price of a call option as strike price plus premium.

gordon-growth-price.name: Gordon Growth Model Price Calculator
gordon-growth-price.intro: Value a stock from expected dividend, required return and growth rate (Gordon growth model).

bond-duration.name: Bond Duration Calculator
bond-duration.intro: Compute the Macaulay and modified duration of a bond from its cash flows.

annualized-volatility.name: Annualized Volatility Calculator
annualized-volatility.intro: Compute annualized volatility as daily volatility times the square root of 252.

tracking-error.name: Tracking Error Calculator
tracking-error.intro: Compute tracking error from a series of active returns.

peg-ratio.name: PEG Ratio Calculator
peg-ratio.intro: Compute the PEG ratio from the P/E ratio and earnings growth rate.

earnings-yield.name: Earnings Yield Calculator
earnings-yield.intro: Compute earnings yield from earnings per share and share price.

fcf-yield.name: FCF Yield Calculator
fcf-yield.intro: Compute the free-cash-flow yield from FCF per share and share price.

ytm-approx.name: Bond YTM Approximation Calculator
ytm-approx.intro: Approximate a bond's yield to maturity from price, coupon and maturity.

current-yield.name: Current Yield Calculator
current-yield.intro: Compute a bond's current yield as annual coupon divided by current price.

ddm-price.name: Dividend Discount Model Price Calculator
ddm-price.intro: Value a stock with the dividend discount model (Gordon growth).

dividend-payout.name: Dividend Payout Ratio Calculator
dividend-payout.intro: Compute the dividend payout ratio from dividend per share and earnings per share.

information-ratio.name: Information Ratio Calculator
information-ratio.intro: Compute the information ratio from a series of active returns.

enterprise-value.name: Enterprise Value Calculator
enterprise-value.intro: Compute enterprise value from market cap, debt and cash.

max-drawdown.name: Maximum Drawdown Calculator
max-drawdown.intro: Compute the maximum drawdown from peak and trough prices.

annualized-vol.name: Annualized Volatility from Daily Vol Calculator
annualized-vol.intro: Convert daily volatility to annualized volatility using the 252-trading-day factor.

market-cap.name: Market Capitalization Calculator
market-cap.intro: Compute market capitalization from share price and total shares outstanding.
